column1: # preflight-facts.tsv — every requirement fact preflight-scan.sh applies. Data only, no logic.
# Currency: the `meta currency` row is THE date for this skill's facts (SKILL.md, checks-*.md and
# the checklist template cite it). /refresh-swift Step 4 edits rows here and never touches
# preflight-scan.sh. ⚠️VOLATILE marks facts that move mid-cycle (litigation, annual SDK
# FIELD rows: a `# <!-- FIELD: … -->` comment protects the rows directly beneath it, up to the
# next blank line (DD-66, DD-78). Refresh passes may append a dated note, version-scope, or
# retire with a citation that shows the mechanism changed — never rewrite or delete.
# Format: TAB-separated, one row per line, `#` comments and blank lines ignored. The scan
# validates every row before scanning and exits 1 naming the line on any problem — a wrong
# field count (tabs turned into spaces), an unknown severity/scope, a rule id the script does
# not emit (or emits but is missing here), or a pattern that does not match its own probe.
# The probe is the per-row positive control: a sample line the pattern must match (DD-77).
#   purpose  <code-ERE>  <required key: A | A/B any-of | A+B all-of>  <optional keys A/B or ->  <probe>
#   sdk      <dep-ERE>   <name>  <probe>        Apple's listed SDKs (ITMS-91061); matched case-insensitively
#   tracker  <dep-ERE>   <name>  <probe>        ad/attribution SDKs for the 3d tracking check
#   depflag  <name>      <dep-ERE>   <probe>    FLAGS routing, from Package.resolved / Podfile.lock
#   verify   <id>        <text>                 VERIFY-BY-HAND line ({key} / {value} filled by the scan)
#   judge    <topic>     <question>             printed once above that topic's JUDGE hits, location "-"
# Messages and questions may use {sdk-floor}; it is filled from the meta row.

column5: CFBundleVersion / CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION: same value on the app and every extension target (Xcode bumps only the app; mismatch fails upload) — one value outside test targets. A rejected version keeps its MARKETING_VERSION; only the build number changes. See review-packet.md
CFBundleVersion / CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION: numeric; increments per upload (redundant-binary rejection). See review-packet.md
Asset catalog needs a 1024×1024 marketing icon, no alpha channel (ITMS-90022/90717). Single-size icon: the one PNG must be 1024², opaque. iOS 18 dark/tinted + iOS 26 .icon variants optional
1024×1024 marketing icon has an alpha channel (ITMS-90022/90717) — the PNG must be opaque
UILaunchScreen dict (even empty, or INFOPLIST_KEY_UILaunchScreen_Generation=YES) or UILaunchStoryboardName required — ITMS-90475 with iPad multitasking; outright mandatory from iOS 27 SDKs
TARGETED_DEVICE_FAMILY includes 2 → all four orientations in the ~ipad set unless UIRequiresFullScreen=YES (ITMS-90474)
⚠️VOLATILE: UIRequiresFullScreen deprecated on iPadOS 26 (will be ignored); durable answer is all four orientations + resizable scenes
UIRequiredDeviceCapabilities: only truly-required values; adding one in an update can never narrow device support (ITMS-90109). Safest: absent or [arm64]
get-task-allow=true in a distribution archive → upload fail
Push registered in code (or Firebase Messaging present) without aps-environment → ITMS-90078 warning
CloudKit sync present but no initializeCloudKitSchema call anywhere — the Development schema is whatever manual testing happened to save (silent post-release failure; see checks-cloudkit.md)
NSAllowsArbitraryLoads=true without per-domain exceptions draws review questions and is a security smell
